evidence_scope.generation_constraint: Generation receives exactly one source_reference image and a self-contained textual prompt.
evidence_scope.recurrence_rule: Only observations recurring across diverse reference images are prompt candidates; individual content and stochastic details are excluded.

observations: All five references are polished editorial anime illustrations
Precise dark ink concentrated on focal forms
medium_rendering.inferred_transferable_rule: Render source-controlled content as a polished editorial anime poster with crisp opaque cel-shaded planes and print separation, not photography or 3D.
prompt_clauses: polished editorial anime poster illustration
crisp opaque cel-shaded value planes and print-like color separation
precise deep-navy ink at focal contours

observations: Saturated teal/cyan, coral/magenta-or-orange, and yellow/ochre supports vary by image
Contrast is primarily adjacent flat value masses rather than photographic gradients
palette_tone.inferred_transferable_rule: Use a limited warm-paper editorial print relationship with dark anchors and restrained saturated accents, while retaining source literal identity through relative semantic-region treatment.
prompt_clauses: limited warm-paper, deep-navy, teal/cyan, coral-or-orange, yellow/ochre, and restrained muted-gold poster-print relationship
preserve source literal color identity; translate only relative values, cel shadows, highlights, contours, and print-facet behavior

observed_relative_behavior.value: luminous light plane with restrained darker warm band
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: subdued relative warmth against saturated supports
observed_relative_behavior.shading: clean cel shadow and narrow highlight

skin.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source skin identity and translate only relative light, shadow, highlight, and contour grouping into graphic cel-shaded planes.
prompt_clauses: render visible skin as source-preserved coherent cel-shaded light, shadow, and narrow highlight planes with selective deep-navy contour
never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity

observed_relative_behavior.chroma: restrained relative cool and warm accents
observed_relative_behavior.shading: separated value blocks and sparse rim/strand planes

hair.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source hair color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity while grouping values into a coherent mass with restrained relative accent planes.
prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity into controlled value blocks with restrained relative cool and warm accent planes and tapered navy contour
do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity

observed_relative_behavior.value: interlocking dark, light, and accent facets
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: limited harmonizing accent relationships rather than wholesale recoloring

clothing.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Keep every source garment silhouette, construction detail, marking, logo, and literal color identity intact; add only restrained source-relative print facets following existing folds and seams.
prompt_clauses: treat clothing as the same source garment: retain its silhouette, construction, markings, logos, and literal color identity
add only restrained source-relative flat print facets following existing folds, with dark seam and edge anchors, sparse harmonizing accent edges, and subtle overprint grain
do not replace, redesign, recolor wholesale, obscure, or remove source garments, markings, or logos

observations: Variable-weight deep-navy or near-black contours recur
Sparse tapered loose strokes extend selected contours
Cropped discs, blocks, rules, brush sweeps, dots, arcs, halftone clusters, and connectors recur as adaptable support forms
line_shape.inferred_transferable_rule: Use decisive variable-weight dark ink and an adaptable abstract support vocabulary without copying literal reference geometry.
prompt_clauses: decisive variable-weight deep-navy ink contours resolving into sparse tapered fine strokes
adaptable abstract discs, blocks, rules, brush sweeps, arcs, dots, halftone clusters, and connectors without copied geometry

observations: Restrained screen-print grain and occasional halftone recur
Broken overprint edges, sparse flecks, and dry-brush interruptions recur
texture_material.inferred_transferable_rule: Add light tactile poster-print texture that preserves source legibility and never copies individual mark trajectories.
prompt_clauses: visible warm paper grain with restrained screen-print speckling, occasional halftone, imperfect overprint edges, sparse paint flecks, and dry-brush interruptions
keep texture away from important source details and legible markings

observations: Broad opaque support fields establish a rhythm around the focal content
Fine ink/muted-gold lines, dots, arcs, and connectors complete the hierarchy
Several but not all references contain display lettering
graphic_language.inferred_transferable_rule: Use adaptable asymmetric poster hierarchy and negative-space rhythm around source-controlled content; lettering is conditional on caller-supplied exact text.
prompt_clauses: place broad opaque abstract support fields behind or around source-controlled content, then add sparse fine muted-gold or ink orbital lines, dots, arcs, and connectors
retain adaptable negative-space rhythm without copying any reference layout

typography_dialogue.activation: Only when optional text is supplied; otherwise render no readable or pseudo-readable text.
typography_dialogue.lettering_or_dialogue_container_medium: High-contrast editorial display ink integrated with the poster-print surface; no mandatory dialogue container.
typography_dialogue.stroke: Elegant readable calligraphic/editorial display stroke with crisp edges and restrained fine detail.
typography_dialogue.hierarchy: The caller-supplied exact string appears once as the only lettering content and remains a restrained display accent.
typography_dialogue.orientation: Adaptive for readability; no fixed reference angle.
typography_dialogue.placement_grammar: Available negative space or a suitable support field, without covering source-controlled content or copying reference placement.
typography_dialogue.ornament: Sparse fine dot/line/arc ornament may frame supplied text but cannot become lettering.
prompt_clauses: only when optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim string once as the only readable or pseudo-readable lettering
use readable high-contrast editorial display ink with elegant calligraphic/display-like strokes, adaptive orientation, open-space placement, and sparse dot/line ornament
do not add any other readable word, pseudo-word, subtitle, article, decorative lexeme, duplicate, or teacher wording/script/language
